calc.areaMedianBody: Every residential-unit sale registered with the Ministry of Justice (weekly open-data bulletin) in the last 12 months, priced as property value ÷ unit area. Units under 25 sqm are excluded. Areas with fewer than 20 deals of their own (for example Qetaifan or Gewan) borrow the parent area's deals.

calc.positionBody: The project's QAR/sqm (developer price ÷ unit size, averaged across the unit mix) is placed against the area's distribution of registered unit deals. Below P25 = below range, above P75 = above range. Off-plan prices often sit above resale because they are for new stock with a payment plan.
calc.yieldBody: Gross yield = median asking rent for the unit type in this area × 12 ÷ the unit's starting price. It ignores service charges, vacancy, furnishing and the time to handover.
calc.areaYieldBody: Indicative price = area median QAR/sqm × typical size for the unit type. Gross yield = median asking rent × 12 ÷ indicative price.
calc.sunBody: Sun position every 10 minutes from SunCalc for this latitude and longitude. A facade gets direct sun when the sun is within 90° of its outward normal and higher than the obstruction angle. The obstruction angle is a heuristic: base angle by density (low 8°, medium 20°, high 32°) minus 1.2° per floor.
calc.livBody: Straight-line distance to the nearest place of each type in the dataset. Each category scores 100 at or within the first distance and 0 at or beyond the second, linearly in between. The total is the weighted average.
calc.noiseBody: Aircraft: each runway's centreline is extended 16 km past both ends as a corridor about 2 km either side, widening with distance. Exposure falls with sideways offset and with distance from the runway end. Road: falls to zero 600 m from a major highway.
calc.residencyBody: Foreign buyers can only own in freehold or usufruct areas. The price is compared with each threshold in the rules table. Thresholds apply to the total value of property owned and can change. Aqarat has the final say.

calc.pulseBody: Residential-unit sales registered with the Ministry of Justice in freehold and usufruct areas, grouped by the week's start month. Only complete months are shown. Median price is the median QAR/sqm of individual sales over the last 3 complete months, compared with the same 3 months a year earlier.
calc.pulseWindow: Median window {a} to {b}: {n} sales · year earlier {c} to {d}: {m} sales
calc.premiumBody: For each apartment unit type with a price and size: QAR/sqm compared with the median of registered sales in the same area and size band (25–75, 75–110, 110–160, 160–250, 250+ sqm) over the last 12 months. Bands with fewer than 8 sales use all sizes. The project's premium is the median across its unit types. Registered sales are mostly completed units, so the premium shows what buyers pay for new stock with a payment plan.
calc.l4lBody: Each unit's starting price ÷ its size, compared with the median QAR/sqm of registered sales in the same size band, same area (or its parent area), last 12 months. Below P25 = below range, above P75 = above range. Villas and townhouses are excluded because the Ministry records give plot area.
calc.bandsBody: Registered sales: Lusail Ministry of Justice unit sales of that size in the last 12 months. Launch: starting price ÷ size for each unit type in Lusail (including Fox Hills) or Qetaifan projects. Premium = launch median ÷ registered median − 1.
calc.netYieldBody: Net yield = (median asking rent × 12 × (1 − vacancy) − service charge × size × 12) ÷ (price × (1 + purchase costs)). Size is the unit's size, or the typical listed size for the rent benchmark.
calc.cfBody: Down payment now; construction instalments monthly over the stated years (or until handover); handover payment at the handover month; post-handover instalments monthly over the stated years. Value today discounts each payment at the discount rate. Investor IRR: purchase costs at the start, net rent from handover, sale at price × (1 + growth)^years less selling costs, with any unpaid instalments settled at sale.
calc.devBody: Premium and payment terms are medians across the developer's projects. Paid by handover uses the first published plan for each project.
calc.taameerBody: Competitor set: the nearest 12 pipeline projects by other developers within 2.5 km (same area when a location is missing). Figures for Taameer projects come from data/taameer_projects.csv.

as.lede: Every Ministry of Justice district is mapped to one of {n} areas. Sales cover the last 52 weeks of registrations ({from} to {to}).
as.mapSize: Circle size shows the measure; colour shows ownership (blue freehold, orange usufruct, grey Qatari & GCC only). Click a circle to open the area.
as.mapShade: Darker blue = higher (quartiles of the areas shown). Pale grey = no data. Click a circle to open the area.
as.notes: Sales: Ministry of Justice weekly bulletins, all property types. Apartment QAR/sqm uses the area's own sales of 25 sqm and over in the last 12 months (8 or more needed). * Borrowed from a neighbouring area: registered QAR/sqm, and rents where the area has none (Qetaifan from Lusail, Gewan from The Pearl). Rents: Property Finder asking rents, all listings in Qatar, monthly. — means no data.
as.calc: Villa and land QAR/sqm divide the price by the plot area, so they are not comparable with apartment QAR/sqm. The 1-year apartment change compares the median of the last 6 months with the same 6 months a year earlier (8 or more sales in each). Gross yield = 2-bed median rent × 12 ÷ (registered apartment QAR/sqm × median 2-bed size); 1-bed when there is no 2-bed sample. Where no apartments trade, the gross yield is a villa yield (median villa rent × 12 ÷ average registered villa price, 5 or more villa sales) and is marked “villa”. Net yield deducts vacancy and service charge and adds purchase costs. Off-plan premium = median of each project's like-for-like premium. Pipeline = tracked and external units handing over this year and the next 3 years.
area.noAptSales: No registered apartment sales in the last 12 months
area.plotTrend: No apartments trade here, so this shows villa and land prices per sqm of plot (months with 3 or more sales).
